# Source and use

Asset: MakeHuman hm08 anatomical base mesh.

- Source: https://github.com/makehumancommunity/makehuman/blob/master/makehuman/data/3dobjs/base.obj
- License: CC0, explicitly stated in the first lines of `base.obj` and the adjacent upstream `LICENSE.md`.
- Downloaded for ATLAS R03 on 2026-09-05.
- Local derivative: posed mesh, workwear material regions, boot uppers, eyes, and rig landmarks in `tools/blender/build_atlas.py`.
- No MakeHuman application source code is included in the model; the graphical asset and its license are retained for traceability.
